meta.title: 那些电影感封面是怎么做的
meta.title_en: How Those Cinematic Covers Are Made
meta.topic: 封面设计 · 电影感构图

scenes.context: 人物居中标题放上面，是经典的电影感构图。普通文字压底部是稳定感构图；标题在左、亮黄色点缀是正能量构图；像PPT文字放右、错位排版是呼吸感构图。语域：封面设计，构图讲解。
sentences: 这是经典的电影感构图。
文字压底部，是稳定感构图。
Text at the bottom gives a stable feel.
paraphrase: 居中 → centered / in the middle
scenes.speak: Subject centered, title on top. That's the classic cinematic composition. Text at the bottom gives a stable feel.

scenes.context: 标牌放中间书法艺术字是国潮感构图。标题填满画面，视觉冲击力强。语域：封面设计，构图讲解。
sentences: 书法艺术字，国潮感构图。
Calligraphy art type gives a neo-Chinese feel.
标题填满画面，冲击力强。
视觉冲击力，让人停下来。
Visual punch makes people stop and look.
paraphrase: 视觉冲击 → visual punch / strong impact
scenes.speak: Calligraphy art type gives a neo-Chinese feel. A full-bleed title hits hard. Visual punch makes people stop and look.

scenes.context: 那些好看的电影海报，八成都是这么设计的。设计了一千多张海报才发现：封面不是让人欣赏的，是让人停下来的。既吸引人又好看，那就是你的本事。语域：封面设计，理念讲解。
sentences: 好看的电影海报，八成都是这么设计的。
Eight in ten great movie posters follow this.
封面不是让人欣赏的，是让人停下来的。
A cover isn't for admiring — it's for stopping.
既吸引人又好看，才是本事。
Drawing eyes and looking good — that's the skill.
paraphrase: 让人停下来 → for stopping / make them pause
scenes.speak: Eight in ten great movie posters follow this. A cover isn't for admiring — it's for stopping. Drawing eyes and looking good — that's the skill.

scenes.context: 先模仿再创新，我们一起前进。电影感封面都是从模仿优秀海报构图开始的。语域：封面设计，收尾。
sentences: imitating great posters（模仿优秀海报）
paraphrase: 模仿创新 → imitate then create / copy to learn
imitate then create · copy to learn
scenes.speak: Imitate first, then create. Start by imitating great posters. Let's move forward together.

practice: Calligraphy art type gives a neo-Chinese feel.

pitfalls: The person is in the middle.

Copy first and then make new.
「先模仿再创新」用 imitate first, then create。
